text:
Sarah Lee: FinSecure POC just hit sustained 5xxs during the sim ramp (~6k rps). Demo tomorrow AM. Need urgent triage — they see 502/503 from the hosted inference endpoint. @Mia @Omar @Lucas
Mia Chen: on it. can you paste root request ids and the exact time window?
Sarah Lee: req ids: fin-9c7a, fin-9c7b. window ~2026-03-21T08:12:05Z -> 08:21:30Z. loadgen uploaded a zip to the drive: https://drive.internal/finsecure-demo-logs.zip
Omar Patel: thanks. first-pass hypothesis: autoscale lag + burstpool exhaustion -> 503s. can we confirm burstpool usage for finsecure-prod? @Lucas are pool metrics available?
Lucas Kim: pulling metrics now. I see a sharp spike at 08:11:55 UTC — burstpool went from 2 -> 0 available in ~30s. autoscale triggered but new nodes registered ~40s after spike. that 30–60s gap matches elevated 5xxs.
Mia Chen: ok that matches previous incidents. quick mitigations: temporarily increase burstpool_size for the POC (console override) and pin routing to a higher-capacity instance type for the demo window. also enable fallback routing to a dedicated low-latency pool if available.
Sarah Lee: is that something I can change from the console, or does eng need to touch infra? customer is also asking about price impact for the temporary bump.
Mia Chen: console path: Console -> Capacity -> Dedicated Overrides -> Burstpool size for the account. Pricing: temporary bump estimate ~+$2.50/hr per added vGPU (i'll follow up with exact numbers).
Omar Patel: also recommend client-side retry/backoff to avoid amplifying the throttle during scale. example config to suggest to the customer:
```
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 2
  backoff: exponential
  base_delay_ms: 200
```
Sarah Lee: do we have logs to prove this is scale lag and not a model crash? customer insists on root cause before demo.
Lucas Kim: grabbing pod logs now: `kubectl logs -n redwood-inference pod/infer-abc123 --since=20m` shows sequence: `enqueue -> dispatch -> scale:init` then several `503: pool exhausted` lines, then `pod registered` and requests succeed. attaching snippet to ticket.
deploy-bot: Auto-deploy notice: scaled up 4 nodes for pool finsecure-prod at 2026-03-21T08:12:50Z
Mia Chen: action items — (1) Omar to open a support ticket with infra and attach logs+metrics. (2) Sarah to request pricing approval for burst bump and confirm demo window. (3) Lucas to provision temporary burstpool bump and enable fallback routing. (4) Mia to draft customer-facing explanation.
Omar Patel: ticket created: SUP-2041. logs + metric links: https://internal.logs/sup2041 and dashboard https://dash.internal/pool/finsecure-prod
Sarah Lee: thanks. i'll message customer: applying hotfix now, will confirm cost impact and follow up.
Mia Chen: also confirm fallback model compatibility — redwood-3b-quant -> redwood-3b-fp16 fallback to avoid regressions in latency/quality.
Sarah Lee: customer OK with fp16 fallback for demo.
Lucas Kim: done — bumped burstpool from 5 -> 15 for finsecure-prod and enabled routing fallback. should clear within ~20s.
Omar Patel: monitoring now — errors trending down.
Sarah Lee: 5xxs cleared, demo is green. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
Mia Chen: i'll write a short postmortem and recommend long-term fixes: pre-warm for big ramps, tune autoscale warmup thresholds, and add pre-ramp capacity rules for POC/demo accounts.
Sarah Lee: please cc me on the PM and the cost estimate.
Lucas Kim: will do.
End.
